title: France Hiring Signals — HelloWork
description: Provide keywords or explicit public SEO start_urls. Runtime validates both modes.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Required in discovery mode (1–10). Trimmed and case-insensitive deduplicated. Optional textual match terms in URL mode.

start_urls.title: Public SEO URLs
start_urls.description: Optional. Takes priority. HTTPS HelloWork /fr-fr/emploi/ SEO URLs, no query or fragment.

location.title: Location
location.description: Supported catalog location only; ignored in explicit URL mode.
